name: Danville Youth Council (DYC)
org: Town of Danville Recreation, Arts and Community Services
what_you_do: Join a teen group in Danville. You help create programs and special events for youth and teens. You also volunteer and donate time and resources to people in need.
who_can_apply: Any Danville resident can join. So can any student enrolled in a Danville middle school or high school. The page gives no age range.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: The page does not give application dates for 2026-27. It lists the 2025-26 meetings: second Monday of the month, September to May, 4:30 to 5:30 PM.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Danville Youth Council application. It is an online form linked on the program page.
notes: Meetings are at the Town Offices, 500 La Gonda Way, Danville. The Teens page says the Town is recruiting for part-time positions in youth and teen programming. It does not give an age for those jobs.
